ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
NIGHT & LIFESTYLE
159
STUDY 113
Red Velvet Hoodie & Space Buns
Rights check / Repeats Study 126.
Source: 25006.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with blonde hair in two high
space buns wears small wire sunglasses and a red
velvet zip hoodie over a burgundy turtleneck. A thin
silver necklace sits at her throat, and a patterned
quilted bag rests on her shoulder. Her expression is
calm and direct. A blurred night street with soft city
lights behind her. Palette of crimson, burgundy, and
midnight blue. Nostalgic and moody, in the style of a
late-1990s film still.
Nostalgic, moody, retro
WORKING NOTES
- The space buns and red velvet are the defining
elements.
- Add 'film grain' for an authentic period look.
